case: OBODO-4 buildup (beginner): 40 shut-in pressures generated by the engine (evaluateBuildup, homogeneous with storage and skin), delivered as src/content/capstone-cases/welltest/obodo4_buildup.csv

beginner.dataset: OBODO-4 buildup file (obodo4_buildup.csv, downloaded from the capstone card): 40 shut-in pressures after 48 h at 620 stb/d, pwf at shut-in 4640.818 psia
beginner.prompt: Analyse the OBODO-4 pressure buildup and report six quantities from ONE fit. Download the buildup file from the capstone case files on this card (40 shut-in times in hours and pressures in psia) and open it in the buildup explorer's Your test mode. The well produced at 620 stb/d for 48 hours and was shut in at a flowing pressure of 4640.818 psia; the reservoir has porosity 0.21, viscosity 1.3 cp, total compressibility 1.1e-5 per psi, wellbore radius 0.3 ft, net pay 62 ft and formation volume factor 1.18 rb/stb. Fit a Horner semilog line by least squares to the TEN points whose shut-in time is 8 hours or more, and report: the permeability that line implies; the skin, taking the line's value at one hour of shut-in as the reference; the magnitude of the semilog slope in psi per cycle; the pressure the line extrapolates to at a Horner ratio of one; the skin pressure drop, and the radius of investigation at the 48 hour producing time. The last two must use the permeability and skin YOU reported.
beginner.why: Section 3 pick A: the buildup explorer opened on the teaching buildup at the capstone window, so all six answers showed on its default state. The capstone moves to the OBODO-4 buildup, delivered as a file and opened in the new Your test mode with the constants the brief states.

obodo_horner_k_md.evidence: Permeability tile prints 40.346 mD; an independent Horner least squares on the file agrees to 1e-9. The planted 42 mD misses by 1.65.

obodo_horner_skin.evidence: Skin tile prints 2.783; tol 0.005. The planted 3.2 misses.

obodo_slope_psi_cycle.evidence: Semilog slope tile prints 61.823 psi per cycle; tol 0.005.

obodo_pstar_psia.evidence: p star tile prints 5200.545 psia without a thousands separator; tol 0.05. The initial 5200 misses.

obodo_skin_dp_psi.evidence: 141.2 q B mu S/(k h) with the reported k and S: 149.39 psi; tol 0.05; the planted k and S miss.

obodo_ri_at_tp_ft.evidence: sqrt(k t/(948 phi mu ct)) at 48 h with the reported k: 824.8 ft; tol 0.5.
